ValidationRule.description: PacPoint KN12222020, PacPoint DL082521 updated for PVL Support Case 15218
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "ADDP - Additional Special Privilege"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "LICF - New License after Forfeiture"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "DUAL - Dual (Sole/RME or RME/RME or RME/Sole)"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "R2DBA - RME to Sole Owner"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RB2SO - RB to Sole Owner"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RELOC - Relocation"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RELOC - Business Site Relocation"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "REAC - Reactivation")),
OR (
AND( ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "H - License Generation"), TEXT(Status__c) = "" ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, "H - License Generation"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"HC - Application Completed"))
)
,
ISBLANK(ApplicationEffectiveDate__c), ISCHANGED( Status__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate the Application Effective Date for this Application Type. This date is the date the ADDP/LICF/REAC/DUAL will be effective.
